I have fought to protect Medicaid from devastating cuts, supported efforts to extend Affordable Care Act tax credits, and worked to preserve vital access to care in our rural communities. I believe health care is a right, and I support universal, affordable coverage. That is why I am fighting to reduce health care costs and expand access to high-quality health care that fits families' budgets. At a time when families are struggling with high prices and a weak job market, Republicans in Congress are doubling down on a health care crisis of their own making. The Committee to Protect Health Care is on the frontlines of fighting back against these attacks, and I am proud to stand with them. # [Trump slams Britain as Burnham seizes UK Prime Minister role](https://substack.com/redirect/18b4b42d-7509-4c29-bc8b-83dc6dff4c75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Andy Burnham was sworn in as the **[United Kingdom's seventh prime minister in a decade on Monday](https://substack.com/redirect/49c8a9be-e5c9-4e5c-82f4-8c3419c35101?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after King Charles invited him to form a government following Keir Starmer's resignation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/18b4b42d-7509-4c29-bc8b-83dc6dff4c75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trump social-media reaction:** President Donald Trump welcomed Burnham's plan to fast-track North Sea oil and gas exploration while calling Britain a "Poverty Stricken Disaster."
* **Economic context given:** UK GDP is projected to grow just 0.8% in 2026 after 1.3% in 2025 and 1% in 2024, with high energy costs cited as a key pressure.
**Socialist direction outlined:** Burnham pledged a new political and economic model that places life's essentials under stronger Government control and uses public procurement to reindustrialize Britain.
* **Market response noted:** Bond-market reaction was muted, with analysts saying most investors do not expect major disruption this year even if longer-term fiscal concerns remain.

# [Spain wins the World Cup as FIFA rakes in $9 Billion](https://substack.com/redirect/18b4b42d-7509-4c29-bc8b-83dc6dff4c75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Spain defeated Argentina 1-0 in extra time to win the 2026 World Cup as FIFA emerged as the financial winner of the expanded 48-team tournament **[that generated more than $9 billion in revenue.](https://substack.com/redirect/a60d5dcb-9f55-42d4-9b85-66c27eacd8c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

---|---|---
* **Final result recorded:** Barcelona forward Ferran Torres scored the only goal after Argentina were reduced to ten men following a second yellow card to Enzo Fernandez.
* **Tournament scale expanded:** The event featured 48 teams and 104 matches over six weeks, with group-stage stadium utilization reaching 99%.
* **Ticket pricing detailed:** Prices ranged from $60 to more than $10,000 with a median above $900, yet demand remained resilient.
* **Future funding planned:** FIFA intends to distribute $2.7 billion in development funding to its 211 member associations between 2027 and 2030.

# [TSMC supercharges Arizona chip plant to ride explosive AI megatrend](https://substack.com/redirect/18b4b42d-7509-4c29-bc8b-83dc6dff4c75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
TSMC is accelerating Arizona factory capacity to capture multi-year AI demand, **[CFO Wendell Huang told CNBC,](https://substack.com/redirect/84a2b590-b967-422c-abf6-696bc661c300?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** adding $100 billion that lifts the total U.S. investment pipeline to $265 billion.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/18b4b42d-7509-4c29-bc8b-83dc6dff4c75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Additional capital committed:** The fresh $100 billion raises TSMC's Arizona total to $265 billion and lifts full-year capital expenditure guidance to between $60 billion and $64 billion.
* **Advanced capacity conversion:** The company is converting 5-nanometer capacity to 3-nanometer and sees 2-nanometer technology as its newest revenue driver heading into the third quarter.
* **Phase one operational:** Phase one using 4-nanometer technology is already running and will grow larger in coming quarters, with both front-end wafer and advanced packaging fabs planned.
* **Cost and focus:** U.S. fab construction costs are four to five times higher than in Taiwan, yet Huang said the firm will not leave any demand on the table.

# [Alphabet stock surges on AI Chip efficiency breakthrough](https://substack.com/redirect/18b4b42d-7509-4c29-bc8b-83dc6dff4c75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Alphabet shares climbed 3% Monday after a report said the company is **[developing a specialized server chip called Frozen v2](https://substack.com/redirect/583413da-f98e-49e4-aa0a-6c115efd3cce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** designed to run Gemini models far more efficiently than current TPUs.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/18b4b42d-7509-4c29-bc8b-83dc6dff4c75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Efficiency gains projected:** Engineers estimate Frozen v2 could deliver six to ten times more tokens per unit of power by embedding parts of Gemini architecture directly into the silicon.
* **2028 deployment target:** The chip is aimed at easing Google's internal compute shortage and is planned as a specialized branch rather than a replacement for general-purpose TPUs.
* **Flexibility trade-off:** The design works only with future Gemini models that keep the same underlying architecture, and the company views it partly as a trial run.
* **Recent compute steps:** Google recently agreed to pay SpaceX nearly $1 billion a month to help meet enterprise compute commitments while developing its own solutions.

# [AMD launches major Microsoft partnership](https://substack.com/redirect/18b4b42d-7509-4c29-bc8b-83dc6dff4c75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
AMD introduced its first rack-scale AI system, Helios, and **[Microsoft announced it will deploy the racks in Azure data centers](https://substack.com/redirect/1ddb77f5-f3d1-443a-915b-54741ed55b45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** alongside early customers Meta, OpenAI and Oracle.

---|---|---
* **Shipping timeline set:** Helios will begin shipping to customers including Microsoft later this year and is positioned as a direct rival to Nvidia's Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin systems.
* **Performance focus stated:** AMD executives emphasize lowest cost per token and strong total cost of ownership, particularly for inference workloads and memory bandwidth.
* **Customer expansion continues:** Microsoft will also add new Azure instances powered by AMD's Venice CPUs for agentic AI and semiconductor design workloads.

# [Ackman sounds alarm: China racing ahead in super-intelligence](https://substack.com/redirect/18b4b42d-7509-4c29-bc8b-83dc6dff4c75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Billionaire investor Bill Ackman warned that China is aggressively **[expanding data-center capacity without the constraints seen in the United States,](https://substack.com/redirect/3b93577d-add7-4717-8e2c-8559f3dbe5cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** placing the race for superintelligence and American democracy at risk.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/18b4b42d-7509-4c29-bc8b-83dc6dff4c75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Direct social-media alert:** Ackman posted that China is not putting moratoriums on data centers and that the United States must win the race or the country and its democracy will be at risk.
* **Corporate investment scale:** Alibaba, Tencent, Baidu and ByteDance are committing tens of billions of dollars to AI infrastructure build-out by 2027.
* **Strategic contrast drawn:** Ackman highlighted U.S. debates over energy use and regulation that have slowed large-scale data-center expansion relative to China.

Strategy stock rose early Monday after the company disclosed[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/9f3fb2e4-cb50-42a4-bfdb-bff8ba01c34c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[it raised $263 million by selling common stock last week](https://substack.com/redirect/9f3fb2e4-cb50-42a4-bfdb-bff8ba01c34c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while neither buying nor selling any bitcoin in the same period.

# Boeing faces years of financial repair before new jet launch
Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg said the company **[will need a couple more years to repair its finances](https://substack.com/redirect/27fc68c6-ce11-4c85-86ec-17fd169a0e11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** before launching a new commercial jet, prioritizing reliability of its current lineup.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4fa82f39-439c-4c9e-afd1-98b22ed4cc68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Three readiness hurdles:** Ortberg listed financial stability, technology readiness and sufficient market demand as requirements before committing to a new aircraft program.
* **Customer feedback received:** Airlines are telling Boeing to focus on improving reliability and production of existing models rather than introducing a successor to the 737 MAX.
* **Airbus timeline shared:** Airbus CEO Guillaume Faury said the company is targeting a next-generation single-aisle jet around 2030 with entry into service in the second half of the decade.
* **Air Force One update:** Boeing will increase spending and add staff to keep the next-generation Air Force One aircraft on schedule for 2028 delivery.

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

name: Jim (Campaign Manager)
subject: FW: I'm asking personally.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Garrity for PA * 4075 Linglestown Rd PMB 119 * Harrisburg, PA 17112-1020 * USA
body:
This campaign is growing because of people like you. But we still have a long way to go.

| | | | | | | Hi Peter,
As Campaign Manager, I have the privilege of seeing this campaign from a perspective that most people don’t.
I see the thousands of miles that Stacy travels every week across the Commonwealth.
I see the volunteers who spend their evenings knocking doors and making phone calls.
I see the crowds at events getting bigger and the momentum continuing to build.
**I also see what it takes to win.**
Running a statewide campaign isn’t cheap. Every day, we’re making decisions about where to travel, how many voters we can reach, and how aggressively we can get our message out.

[**HELP US KEEP BUILDING MOMENTUM**](https://us.list-manage.com/E1SnHZUMTny?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)

Meanwhile, Josh Shapiro has every advantage that comes with being the incumbent. He has national donors.
He has outside groups ready to spend millions.
He has the political establishment lining up behind him.
We know we’re going to be outspent.
But campaigns aren’t won because one side has more money.
**They’re won because one side has more people willing to stand up and say I’m in.**
That’s what has brought us this far.
**And that’s what’s going to win this race.**
Every contribution – whether it’s $10, $25, or $100 – helps us reach more voters, expand our grassroots organization, and make sure Stacy’s message reaches every corner of Pennsylvania.
The truth is simple:
**If thousands of supporters each do a little, together we can accomplish something extraordinary.**
That’s how grassroots campaigns win.
**And that’s exactly how we’re going to defeat Josh Shapiro.**

[**MAKE A CONTRIBUTION**](https://us.list-manage.com/Ml1kew1bx04?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)

Thank you for believing in this campaign and for everything you’ve done to help us build it.
Now help us finish the job.
Sincerely,
Jim T. Campaign ManagerGarrity for Governor

body:
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
You are invited to join our one-click issue response poll.
For data integrity purposes, please do not complete this survey if your email address is not dpwillis67@gmail.com .
Recently, Trump ally Steve Bannon spoke about the midterm elections on his podcast. He said:
“ You’re damn right, we’re going to have ICE surround the polls come November. We’re not going to sit here and allow you to steal the country again. And you can whine and cry and throw your toys out of the pram all you want, but we will never again allow an election to be stolen .”
Bannon's comments come after more than a year of controversy, with accusations flying that Trump is using ICE as a personal army to take over different cities around the country like LA, Chicago, and Minneapolis, among others.
Team: We're looking to hear from our supporters about this threat. Will you take our one-question poll right away?
Team: Are you in favor of sending ICE to "surround" our polling places?
By clicking a response below, your answer will be automatically recorded:
YES [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-pollresponse?refcode=072026_2yes&amount=15] NO [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-pollresponse?refcode=072026_2no&amount=15]

https://www.facebook.com/voteraction [https://www.facebook.com/voteraction] https://bsky.app/profile/voteractionproject.org [https://bsky.app/profile/voteractionproject.org] https://www.instagram.com/voteractionproj/ [https://www.instagram.com/voteractionproj/] https://www.linkedin.com/company/voter-action-project/ [https://www.linkedin.com/company/voter-action-project/]
Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. Peter, don’t fall for it. Georgia’s legislative leaders pulled the plug on a special session push to redraw Georgia’s maps — but don’t think for a second that they’ve given up. Republicans in the state didn’t suddenly have a democratic awakening. They’ve only put a pause on their plans to further gerrymander because of the public outcry from voters who made it abundantly clear that drawing Black voters out of power is unacceptable. They knew if they moved forward, there would be massive blowback in this election. That’s why anti-democracy forces are waiting — we expect them to try to sneak through an even more gerrymandered map again _after_ the midterm elections — during the lame duck session. We need to be ready. **The NDRC is pushing back against MAGA’s efforts to manipulate our maps — and Georgia is just one state looking to redraw for 2028. [](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/mscl-endorse-cooper-0626-email/?source=email_su_pros_jtk832&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=8&akid=2220%2E124072%2EYhQFQu)
Peter, I’ve been crisscrossing the state on my Make Stuff Cost Less campaign tour, talking with and listening to North Carolinians directly, and I keep hearing versions of the same thing:
🚨 Everything from gas to groceries is getting unaffordable.

🏠 Buying a house and planning for the future seems unthinkable.

🇺🇲 The American Dream feels unattainable.
**Stuff costs too much, and nobody in Washington DC seems to care.**
When I hear things like this, I know it’s time to get to work. That’s why I’m in this fight. As North Carolina’s next U.S. Senator, I will put the people before power, party and politics – as I did for eight years as Governor:
✅ We expanded Medicaid for hundreds of thousands of working North Carolinians.

✅ We added hundreds of thousands of good-paying jobs.

✅ We increased teacher pay and expanded paid parental leave.
**Now, I’m ready to bring this North Carolina common sense to the U.S. Senate – but I need your help. The GOP is going all in to defeat me, and only by building a powerful grassroots team can I fight back and win.**

Your grandfather's hardware store.
Your mom's pharmacy.
The diner on Main Street.
They didn't lose to a better product.
They lost because Congress let someone rig the game.
**WHAT WE USED TO HAVE**
I'm Melissa Chaudhry. Candidate for Congress in Washington's 9th Congressional district.
And I want to tell you about three laws.
Laws America used to have.
Laws that protected you.
That protected your neighbor's small business.
Gone.
1.
In 1936, Congress passed the Robinson-Patman Act.
It said a supplier couldn't charge your local grocer more than it charged a giant chain for the exact same order.
It kept the playing field level.
That law is still on the books today.
Congress just stopped enforcing it. In 1981.
That's the year the corner store started losing to the giant chain -- because Congress let the suppliers cheat.
2.
In 1933, Congress built a wall between your savings account and Wall Street's casino, because the crash of 1929 showed us that financial institutions love to gamble with your money.
It was called the Glass-Steagall Act
In 1999, Congress tore most of that wall down.
Overnight, the bank holding your paycheck and the casino gambling with your retirement were allowed to become the same company--putting your life savings on the line without you ever signing a permission slip.
Nine years later, we had the worst financial crisis since the Great Depression.
The '08 Global Financial Collapse would have NEVER happened if Congress had been doing its job. We still have Congresspeople in office who did that. Adam Smith, who I'm running to unseat, has been in Congress since 1997.
3.
For seventy years, the Public Utility Holding Company Act stood between your electric bill and corporate raiders.
It said: if you want to sell power, you have to make power--not just gamble on it.
In 2005, Congress tore that down. Mega-mergers swept the country. Competition shrank. Prices rose.
And your monthly bill became just another number on a speculator's spreadsheet.
**ACT TWO -- THE PATTERN**
None of this was an accident.
Every one of these laws and protections was dismantled by the same thing --
Not one cartoon villain.
A system.
Paid lobbyists.
Quiet votes.
And Members of Congress choosing donors over their constituents -- again, and again, and again.
They didn't just fail to stop monopolies.
They built them.
That's why your life is expensive.
Your utility bill. Your retirement. Your college education. Your investments. Your dream small business. Your lifetime savings.
Congress has been going against your interests in ALL of them. Tipping the scales in favor of the billionaires to pad their pockets.
**ACT THREE -- WHAT COURAGE LOOKS LIKE**
Now me? I've spent twenty years finding, learning, and practicing the best alternatives in the world -- on five continents.
Worker-owned cooperatives. Community land trusts. Small businesses with a level playing field and opportunity to grow.
Systems where power is shared, not hoarded. Where the economy is a resilient ecosystem with many options that benefits everyone, instead of a handful of monopolies owning everything and no room to take initiative anymore.
Congress sold you out. Stripped away laws that protected your family and your livelihood, all to please their donors.
I'll fight to get those protections back.
\- Enforce the laws already on the books -- starting with Robinson-Patman.
\- Rebuild the wall between community banking and Wall Street speculation.
\- Break up the mergers that turned your utility bill into somebody else's private equity return.
And I'll take zero corporate PAC money doing it. No foreign interests. No defense contractors. No killer robot money. I am, and will remain, financially accountable ONLY to we the people.
Not because it's radical.
Because it's what Congress used to do -- before it forgot who it worked for.
Care.
Courage.
The Constitution.

Lorena García’s nonprofit took $6.6 million in state money while its lobbyist backed bills she sponsored
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**July 20, 2026** **MONDAY NEWS DIGEST**
| | Dear Rocky Mountain Voice family,
One of Rocky Mountain Voice's core missions is simple:
Follow the facts. Follow the money. And ask the questions others won't.
This week, our latest original investigation does exactly that.
Our reporting found that before Rep. Lorena García joined the Colorado legislature, the nonprofit she leads had received just under $13,000 in state funding over five years. Since taking office in January 2023, that same nonprofit has received [more than $6.6 million in state payments](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)—representing nearly all of the state funding it has received since 2018.
The investigation also examines the relationship between those contracts and García's legislative role. While serving in the House, García sponsored or co-sponsored several child care bills that were [actively supported by her nonprofit's paid lobbyist](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
RMV also reviewed public financial records showing compensation paid to García through the nonprofit, as well as payments to members of her family that were disclosed in IRS filings. The article also [outlines García's responses](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), including her explanation that her salary comes from private philanthropy rather than state contracts and that the organization competed for and won its contracts through the state's standard procurement process.
The investigation also highlights what could come next. State Sen. Byron Pelton has said he plans to introduce legislation in 2027 that would [prohibit legislators from receiving compensation from nonprofits while serving in office](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), after a similar amendment failed this session with opposition from 13 Democratic senators.

Whether lawmakers choose to close what some see as an ethics gap for nonprofit-employed legislators—or address similar questions involving lawmakers whose private businesses benefit from legislation—will likely be a debate waiting for the next General Assembly.
**🎥 RMV's Freedom Festival Is Coming to YouTube!** If you weren't able to join us at Freedom Fest—or if you want to relive your favorite moments—you won't have to wait much longer.
This week we'll begin releasing full keynote speeches, interviews, and behind-the-scenes moments from Freedom Fest on the Rocky Mountain Voice YouTube channel.
From Greg Gutfeld and Lara Logan to Secretary of Energy Chris Wright, Nick Shirley, Dr. Kevin Roberts, Pastor Lorenzo Sewell, Erin Lee, and many more, you'll be able to watch the conversations that made this year's event one of the biggest patriotic gatherings Colorado has ever seen.
We'll be releasing new videos throughout the week, so be sure to _**[subscribe to our YouTube channel](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_ and follow our social media pages so you don't miss a single one.
Thank you, as always, for supporting our little corner of conservative reporting in Colorado.
In truth & liberty,
Team RMV

body:

Tomorrow is Congressman Jim Clyburn’s birthday, and I know there’s one gift in particular he would appreciate today:

Hey folks,
This one starts completely off the rails--in the best way possible. [Jessiah](https://open.substack.com/users/98509326-jessiah?utm_source=mentions) and I somehow spend the first few minutes talking about Billy Joel, _Piano Man_ , improv comedy, and family stories before making a hard pivot into one of the most serious conversations we've had in a while.
We break down Trump's latest international embarrassment at the World Cup, what it says about America's standing in the world, and then spend most of the conversation digging into the escalating conflict with Iran, the human cost of war, and why accountability matters. We got personal. We got angry. Don't miss this one.
**Here are some moments you don 't want to miss:**
* **00:01:07** Mike shares a hilarious theory about _Piano Man_ that completely changes how you'll hear the song forever--and the conversation spirals into family stories, marriage, and identity.
* **00:06:15** We pivot to Trump's appearance at the World Cup, the global reaction, and what another public humiliation says about America's reputation abroad.
* **00:13:46** The conversation turns to the escalating Iran conflict, mounting casualties, and why official narratives deserve far more scrutiny.
* **00:16:02** We talk about who pays the real price for political decisions, the families left behind, and why endless wars continue despite their devastating human cost.
* **00:24:20** We close with a broader conversation about elections, accountability, and why political decisions have real-life consequences that extend far beyond Washington.

This episode covers everything from political theater to the devastating reality of war, but at its core it's about responsibility. We talk about leadership, truth, the lives affected by policy decisions, and why informed citizens can't afford to tune out. If you're looking for a conversation that's honest, passionate, and willing to wrestle with difficult issues, this one's essential. And if you value conversations like these, help me keep building them.

Francesca

| Friend,
---
I had fallen into a coma, was placed on a ventilator, stared death in the eyes, and was even read my last rites.
---
But honestly, that’s not the shocking part of this story.
---
**_What’s truly unfathomable is what I saw when I awoke from a coma..._**
---
I had just cheated death – and the Radical Left felt it was the __perfect_ _time__ for them to double down on their pursuit to destroy me.
---
_**After waking from my coma, I came to discover that the Democrat Attorney General seeking to JAIL me for LIFE is now pursuing a _BRAND_ _NEW_ _INDICTMENT_ against yours truly!**_
---
Never did I think I would cross paths with such vindictive and vile people, Friend.
---
_The worst part? This Democrat AG is relentlessly targeting me solely because she believes she will _score political points_ with her base in the upcoming election._
---
I’ll be honest, during my coma, I had a deeply spiritual experience.
---
Humbly, I cannot say I was headed straight for heaven. Rather, it felt like I was headed to a trial by St. Peter where all my life’s deeds were put on display.
---
That moment put everything in perspective for me.
---
No matter what happens in my RIGGED CASE, the ONLY trial that ultimately matters is the one before God.
---
**And I can say with absolute confidence that when I was tested, I chose to stand by my principles – even if it meant getting _ARRESTED_ ... _TWICE!_**
---
_Do you think this Democrat AG can say the same?_
---
_But to win this case, I’m going to need the BEST defense I can get._
---
**_Just as I heavily relied on your prayers when I was in a coma, I’m honestly going to need your support to secure a top-notch defense to beat the left-wing prosecutor hell-bent on throwing me in prison._**
---
And to ensure I can retain this top-notch defense, I’ve set a goal of **$231,375.70** for the Rudy Defense Trust – my ONLY hope of beating this sham indictment.
---
But that goal isn’t _just_ the amount I believe it will take to beat these charges and WIN this case, it’s also the very number under which the Democrats unjustly **_BOOKED_** me in one of the most violent jails in America!
---

| |

Hi friend! 👋 I'm Chintan, the new Organizing Director on Nellie Pou's re-election campaign. My job is to build the grassroots operation that will power this campaign to victory in November: recruiting and training volunteers, organizing canvasses and phone banks, and making sure every corner of NJ-09 knows what's at stake in this election. What really excites me about this opportunity is that this is one of the most important races in the entire county. Hope to hear from you!

Hi Peter,

The Indiana Democratic Party is proud to announce the members of the 2026–2027 Emerging Leaders Project, welcoming the program's 13th class of rising Democratic leaders from communities across Indiana.

This year's cohort includes 40 talented young Hoosiers selected through a highly competitive application process. Over the coming year, participants will receive training in campaign strategy, fundraising, communications, public policy, and leadership—preparing them to make a lasting impact as candidates, campaign professionals, party leaders, and community advocates.

"The Emerging Leaders Project provides free, high-quality training for young Democrats who are passionate about public service and strengthening our party," said Jeff Harris, Chair of Emerging Leaders Project, Inc. "Each year, we select an exceptional group from hundreds of applicants, and this class continues that tradition. Our alumni have gone on to serve in the Indiana General Assembly, run statewide campaigns, hold local elected office, lead Democratic organizations, and manage winning campaigns across Indiana. I'm excited to see the difference this new class will make in the years ahead."

Since its founding in 2011, the Emerging Leaders Project has helped develop hundreds of Democratic leaders who continue to shape the future of Indiana through public service, political engagement, and community leadership.

Please join us in congratulating and welcoming the 2026–2027 Emerging Leaders Project Class:

body:
Friend,

We are just months away from the first votes being cast in the Midterms, and what I'm looking at right now could spell disaster for our Republican Senate Majority.
**["POLLS SHOW AN ENTHUSIASM GAP BETWEEN DEMOCRATS AND REPUBLICANS GOING INTO MIDTERMS"](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckjGP3CwQhn8N7mzZgw124eKTrJW-4tLcKikRC-PdOWFwAHvz8yOyd0XatI9mhud9xY839abJkb9_0xvOlJKKSeUHJRMOZ9OOzllKOmWMCloQdStraJU2mU5Uva7sPEA3rmOFcyfHfpBCgqweM1_73o4Dcokc1lHAdGtR3DSX7So5rBXN5V4roe2mfoChsePa3SYcuOzkqruR9e2xW52xIZ_IYjIh7HtwlMmkJsR75eZHznti_D8GFwaXhOaI2DzJR7SNCRuDi4_JMLic58_6w2F24VljveuywC9H3tSGlo6N8QU3TY6BKDCFIxpkfAmwqTL9h2bD-PL_-3v9Zf7Jjd52TXfP-HKGjPHESCsZnSn4vyqsP5z6tFAvsdd-8Bl9ZnxZD2-jpkT-zkDoLe8hUTnD-NK_SM_40rXl6VjixjLKlxwPZCDwl8pkGV--DNX1Wn-_Nl0n-3FSuZsEwCTqQQ5VnO3-JOcoCcn69l7il9Kq_C__4JzhdwAAAP__2izCKA)**
According to this report, **[just 28%](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckjGP3CwQhn8N7mzZgw124eKTrJW-4tLcKikRC-PdOWFwAHvz8yOyd0XatI9mhud9xY839abJkb9_0xvOlJKKSeUHJRMOZ9OOzllKOmWMCloQdStraJU2mU5Uva7sPEA3rmOFcyfHfpBCgqweM1_73o4Dcokc1lHAdGtR3DSX7So5rBXN5V4roe2mfoChsePa3SYcuOzkqruR9e2xW52xIZ_IYjIh7HtwlMmkJsR75eZHznti_D8GFwaXhOaI2DzJR7SNCRuDi4_JMLic58_6w2F24VljveuywC9H3tSGlo6N8QU3TY6BKDCFIxpkfAmwqTL9h2bD-PL_-3v9Zf7Jjd52TXfP-HKGjPHESCsZnSn4vyqsP5z6tFAvsdd-8Bl9ZnxZD2-jpkT-zkDoLe8hUTnD-NK_SM_40rXl6VjixjLKlxwPZCDwl8pkGV--DNX1Wn-_Nl0n-3FSuZsEwCTqQQ5VnO3-JOcoCcn69l7il9Kq_C__4JzhdwAAAP__2izCKA)** of Republicans say they're very enthusiastic about voting this November. For Democrats, it's 47%.

But I'll be honest with you, Friend -- _**[I don't believe that number for a second.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckjGP3CwQhn8N7mzZgw124eKTrJW-4tLcKikRC-PdOWFwAHvz8yOyd0XatI9mhud9xY839abJkb9_0xvOlJKKSeUHJRMOZ9OOzllKOmWMCloQdStraJU2mU5Uva7sPEA3rmOFcyfHfpBCgqweM1_73o4Dcokc1lHAdGtR3DSX7So5rBXN5V4roe2mfoChsePa3SYcuOzkqruR9e2xW52xIZ_IYjIh7HtwlMmkJsR75eZHznti_D8GFwaXhOaI2DzJR7SNCRuDi4_JMLic58_6w2F24VljveuywC9H3tSGlo6N8QU3TY6BKDCFIxpkfAmwqTL9h2bD-PL_-3v9Zf7Jjd52TXfP-HKGjPHESCsZnSn4vyqsP5z6tFAvsdd-8Bl9ZnxZD2-jpkT-zkDoLe8hUTnD-NK_SM_40rXl6VjixjLKlxwPZCDwl8pkGV--DNX1Wn-_Nl0n-3FSuZsEwCTqQQ5VnO3-JOcoCcn69l7il9Kq_C__4JzhdwAAAP__2izCKA)**_

_Not yet, anyway._

Friend,

A Los Angeles mayoral candidate, Nithya Raman, recently proposed banning backyard barbecues.

No, this is not satire.

A candidate for mayor of America's second-largest city looked at her constituents cooking dinner in their own backyards and saw a problem that needed a government solution.

This is what Ayn Rand described decades ago.

She wrote, _" We are fast approaching the stage of ultimate inversion: the stage where the government is free to do anything it pleases, while the citizens may act only by permission."_

While she was not talking about barbecues, Ayn Rand was talking about the mindset that eventually gets around to barbecues, because **once the state believes it owns your judgment** -- and your property -- your grill is just the next line item.

Friend, this is exactly the kind of small, absurd, telling moment that shows young people what collectivism actually looks like when it runs out of bigger things to control.

I'm Jennifer Anju Grossman, CEO of The Atlas Society, the largest organization in the world dedicated to bringing Ayn Rand's ideas to a new generation. We create graphic novels, animated videos, a hit podcast, and a growing slate of educational programs, all designed to meet young people exactly where they already are, on the platforms they already use, in formats built to actually hold their attention.

clean_body: Friend, A Los Angeles mayoral candidate, Nithya Raman, recently proposed banning backyard barbecues. No, this is not satire. A candidate for mayor of America's second-largest city looked at her constituents cooking dinner in their own backyards and saw a problem that needed a government solution. This is what Ayn Rand described decades ago. She wrote, " We are fast approaching the stage of ultimate inversion: the stage where the government is free to do anything it pleases, while the citizens may act only by permission." While she was not talking about barbecues, Ayn Rand was talking about the mindset that eventually gets around to barbecues, because once the state believes it owns your judgment -- and your property -- your grill is just the next line item. Friend, this is exactly the kind of small, absurd, telling moment that shows young people what collectivism actually looks like when it runs out of bigger things to control. I'm Jennifer Anju Grossman, CEO of The Atlas Society, the largest organization in the world dedicated to bringing Ayn Rand's ideas to a new generation. We create graphic novels, animated videos, a hit podcast, and a growing slate of educational programs, all designed to meet young people exactly where they already are, on the platforms they already use, in formats built to actually hold their attention. You can put Rand 's ideas in front of more young minds this week, at the exact moment they need to see the pattern, by chipping in $10 or more right now. A councilwoman proposing to regulate your summer cookout is not a fluke. It is what happens downstream of a generation raised to believe that ordinary freedom is itself the emergency. Recent polling has found that 62% of young Americans view socialism favorably, not as a historical curiosity but as a live option. This is not an accident. It is the product of a curriculum that treats achievement as suspect, treats the builders as villains, and treats envy as a form of justice. The Atlas Society is interrupting that pipeline before it finishes the job. We are reaching young people where they already are, on the platforms they already use, with content sharp enough to actually compete for their attention. Our digital reach now stands at 3.5 million. We have 22 John Galt Schools running on five continents. We have produced 42 Draw My Life videos that make Rand's ideas make sense to a 19-year-old scrolling at midnight. That is the whole model. Meet them where they are. Give them Ayn Rand 's ideas before the other side finishes giving them the alternative. One billion young minds is the number we are building toward, one grill joke, one viral video, one Pocket Guide at a time. Every $10 you give reaches 2,000 more of them. With grit, grace, and gratitude, Jennifer Anju Grossman (JAG) CEO, The Atlas Society The Atlas Society is a 501(c)(3) Not For Profit Organization. All donations are tax-deductible.

body:
Let's be honest about what Donald Trump has done to this country.

He has weaponized the government against its own people, hollowed out our
institutions, enabled ICE to brutalize our communities, and stripped our
country for parts to be sold to the highest bidder in order to enrich
himself. Perhaps worst of all, he has made cruelty his policy.

The costs of all of this are real — we see them in rising prices, in the
loss of our civil liberties, and in the fear that too many Americans are
living with on a daily basis.

But here's what Mary Trump has always known about Donald: he counts on us
being so demoralized by the chaos he unleashes that we will give up.

He couldn’t be more wrong.

That's why Mary launched Transcend PAC, a team dedicated to electing bold
leaders who have the courage to restore accountability, protect our
institutions, and transcend this dark era in our country’s history.

Transcend PAC endorses and directly contributes to candidates who offer a
transformative vision for America’s future, including: government
accountability; taxing billionaires; regulating big tech; advocating for
real climate solutions; strengthening our civil rights protections;
reforming our institutions; increasing wages; and rebuilding and
fortifying our education, healthcare, housing, and infrastructure.

This is the solution to everything Donald and a complicit Republican Party
have done: Organized action to support candidates and causes that pledge
to do the work that will lead to real, substantive change. [ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260720-split.Zpgrfx&refcode=em20260720-61646&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=61646%2E1407376%2EzTh2lF ]Will you

name: Protect PA Farmland
subject: Help Save Janet's Farm
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Garrity for PA * 4075 Linglestown Rd PMB 119 * Harrisburg, PA 17112-1020 * USA
body:
At 71 years old, Janet wrote to an elected official for the first time. Now she needs your help.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/1B62vRIH3bx?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
| | | | | | Peter,

At 71 years old, Janet Sellard never imagined she would be writing to an elected official.
But after spending years to preserve her family's farm in Union County, she believes **it could now be threatened by a proposed transmission line tied to a massive data center project.**
Recently, Stacy traveled to Union County to meet with Janet, her family, and her neighbors to hear their concerns firsthand.
What she found wasn't politics.
It was hardworking Pennsylvanians fighting to protect the land their families have cared for for generations.
**Take a few minutes to watch Janet's story.**
---
| [WATCH THE VIDEO](https://us.list-manage.com/ri01jxmidsn?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
---
| |
Pennsylvania can welcome economic development without sacrificing the farms that feed our Commonwealth.
Janet and farmers throughout Pennsylvania deserve transparency, respect, and the assurance that every reasonable alternative will be considered before their land is permanently changed.
By signing this petition, you'll be joining thousands of Pennsylvanians calling on PPL, project developers, and state leaders to protect Janet's farm by selecting a transmission route that avoids preserved farmland whenever a reasonable alternative exists.
Janet had the courage to speak up.
Now it's our turn to stand with her.

|
Peter,
North Carolina is a bright spot for Senate Democrats in a difficult election cycle just made harsher by the implosion of the Graham Platner campaign in Maine.
But while the Dem nominee Gov. Roy Cooper is in a good position to win his election and boost Democrats' numbers in the Senate, the Democratic incumbent in the crucial state Supreme Court race Anita Earls has been all but left to fend for herself against a well-funded MAGA opposition that has prioritized state-level races for decades.
Justice Earls is currently one of two Democrats on the court. If she loses, the court becomes a 6-1 MAGA majority.
The stakes are higher and more brutal than any other state in the country: extremists in the NC legislature have been launching increasingly bold pushes to make the state's existing 12 week abortion ban even more extreme--including renewed efforts to penalize women seeking abortions with charges of murder, a capital offense in a state with the death penalty.
It is no exaggeration to say if MAGA prevails here, matters of life and death for millions of North Carolina women could be in the hands of 6 Republican justices and one lone Democrat.

One such proposed bill reads: "Any person who willfully seeks to destroy the life of another person, by any means, at any stage of life, or succeeds in doing so, shall be held accountable for attempted murder or for first degree murder, respectively."
Even if this particular bill doesn't pass, it will be far from the last attempt MAGA will make to punish women and doctors.
In 2028, three of the five current Republican justices will be up for reelection. If Earls can hold onto this seat this year, Dems will have an opportunity to flip the NC Supreme Court on its head: going from a 5-2 GOP majority to a 5-2 Democratic majority.
But MAGA is preparing a last minute assault to steal this seat from Democrats and put our ability to flip control of this crucial state supreme court completely out of reach for decades.
Defend Our Courts is one of the last remaining bulwarks against MAGA's stealthy campaigns to win state-level races that typically fly under the radar for most Democrats. But while the Dem nominee Gov. Roy Cooper is in a good position to win his election and boost Democrats' numbers in the Senate, the Democratic incumbent in the crucial state Supreme Court race Anita Earls has been all but left to fend for herself against a well-funded MAGA opposition that has prioritized state-level races for decades. Justice Earls is currently one of two Democrats on the court. If she loses, the court becomes a 6-1 MAGA majority. The stakes are higher and more brutal than any other state in the country: extremists in the NC legislature have been launching increasingly bold pushes to make the state's existing 12 week abortion ban even more extreme--including renewed efforts to penalize women seeking abortions with charges of murder, a capital offense in a state with the death penalty. It is no exaggeration to say if MAGA prevails here, matters of life and death for millions of North Carolina women could be in the hands of 6 Republican justices and one lone Democrat. | == One such proposed bill reads: "Any person who willfully seeks to destroy the life of another person, by any means, at any stage of life, or succeeds in doing so, shall be held accountable for attempted murder or for first degree murder, respectively." Even if this particular bill doesn't pass, it will be far from the last attempt MAGA will make to punish women and doctors. In 2028, three of the five current Republican justices will be up for reelection. If Earls can hold onto this seat this year, Dems will have an opportunity to flip the NC Supreme Court on its head: going from a 5-2 GOP majority to a 5-2 Democratic majority. But MAGA is preparing a last minute assault to steal this seat from Democrats and put our ability to flip control of this crucial state supreme court completely out of reach for decades. Friends,
One of the things I'm most proud of about this campaign is how we've built it. Not through television ads. Not by chasing the biggest checks. And not by spending my days cozying up to billionaires and Corporate PACs.
We've built it by showing up.
Over the past several months, I've traveled to every corner of this district. I've sat around kitchen tables, talked in coffee shops, walked in parades, attended county fairs, and met with workers, business owners, farmers, teachers, veterans, and families. However, unlike my opponent, I do not and will never take corporate money. I rely solely on support from people like you to pay dedicated staff and to support and coordinate our volunteer efforts.
As we get closer to the election, every dollar matters more than ever — because the opposition is starting to realize we’re a genuine threat, and they’re pouring millions into advertising and campaign events in order to keep us from taking away their power. This is our last chance to fight back.

Trina Swanson

Archer just dumped pure commercial eVTOL delays and pivoted hard into defense with Anduril on the autonomous Thunder VTOL. Stock ripped over 20%. Goldstein is still talking 2028 Olympics certification for the civilian side, but the real money is the warfighter market that skips the endless FAA circus. This is capital chasing the path of least regulation and highest urgency.
* **Winners?** Archer shareholders and Anduril. Defense budgets don't care about emissions theater. Anyone long the hybrid military VTOL story just got paid.
* **Losers?** Pure-play commercial eVTOL dreamers still waiting on infrastructure and regulators. Their timelines keep slipping while defense prints.
* **Next?** More dual-use deals. Trump's pilot programs already greasing the skids across 26 states. Expect contract chatter and another leg higher if the Pentagon bites.
*

Anduril kept showing up as the quiet innovator. Commercial air taxis were always the long shot. Military is the near-term cash machine. Load the ones shipping hardware that actually gets used. The rest can keep begging for certificates.

The evidence for ancient Egyptian aliens is bizarre and impossible to explain. Historical legends of "Gods" that came from the sky on flying discs... The Temple of Seti hieroglyph from 1239 BC showing a helicopter, submarine, and airplane...

Friend,
In 250 years of American history, we have never faced a moment quite like this one.
**The Democratic Party is being swallowed whole by an openly socialist, anti-American wing.**
This is not name-calling. Their own platform calls for gutting our military, nationalizing private companies, abolishing cash bail, throwing open the border, and handing voting rights to noncitizens.
Their radicals are beating establishment Democrats in primary after primary. Zohran Mamdani was just the beginning.
_But here is what most Americans still do not understand, and it worries me deeply._
**The Democrats have already rigged the system. And they did it through illegal immigration.**
It works like this. Our Census counts every single resident, citizens and illegal aliens alike, when it hands out House seats and Electoral College votes.
So every illegal alien sitting in a blue state quietly pads that state's power in Washington, D.C.
Elon Musk has been sounding the alarm on this, and he is exactly right. Record illegal immigration has already shifted an estimated 15 to 20 House seats toward the Left.
Now you understand why they fight secure borders and deportations so ferociously.
**That is the entire scheme. Flood the country. Inflate the count. Redraw the maps. Lock in permanent one-party power. **
President Trump fought to base representation on American citizens where it belongs. The courts blocked him at every turn. But the plot is now out in the open for all of us to see.
Which brings me to the SAVE Act, and to my single greatest fear in this fight...
Not enough Americans even know what it is. **One poll found that only 23% could accurately describe it.** That is a catastrophe, because you cannot rally the people to save something they have never had explained to them.
**So let me tell you plainly what this bill does: The SAVE Act bars noncitizens from voting, so that only American citizens ever cast a ballot in an American election. And it requires photo ID to vote.** _**Period.** _
That is the whole fight, in two sentences.
And the American people are with us by margins you almost never see in politics. Nearly 80% want proof of citizenship to register. More than 8 in 10 support voter ID, including most Democrats, most independents, every background and every region. It is 5 to 1.
**Yet every single Democrat is fighting to block it.** _**Every one.** _
I have spent a lifetime in these battles, and I will tell you the hard truth. You never win reform inside Washington, D.C. The lobbyists and the entrenched forces always control the inside game.
Reagan understood this. His job, he said, was to shine a light on the American people so they would turn up the heat on Congress. Tip O'Neill once admitted to me that Reagan's speeches cost him 46 Democrats in a single fight.
**That is exactly how we win this one. Not with insiders. With a grassroots army of patriots like you, moving all at once.**

clean_body: I'm deeply worried and would like to connect with you today | | | | | | | | Friend, In 250 years of American history, we have never faced a moment quite like this one. The Democratic Party is being swallowed whole by an openly socialist, anti-American wing. This is not name-calling. Their own platform calls for gutting our military, nationalizing private companies, abolishing cash bail, throwing open the border, and handing voting rights to noncitizens. Their radicals are beating establishment Democrats in primary after primary. Zohran Mamdani was just the beginning. But here is what most Americans still do not understand, and it worries me deeply. The Democrats have already rigged the system. And they did it through illegal immigration. It works like this. Our Census counts every single resident, citizens and illegal aliens alike, when it hands out House seats and Electoral College votes. So every illegal alien sitting in a blue state quietly pads that state's power in Washington, D.C. Elon Musk has been sounding the alarm on this, and he is exactly right. Record illegal immigration has already shifted an estimated 15 to 20 House seats toward the Left. Now you understand why they fight secure borders and deportations so ferociously. That is the entire scheme. Flood the country. Inflate the count. Redraw the maps. Lock in permanent one-party power. President Trump fought to base representation on American citizens where it belongs. The courts blocked him at every turn. But the plot is now out in the open for all of us to see. Which brings me to the SAVE Act, and to my single greatest fear in this fight... Not enough Americans even know what it is. One poll found that only 23% could accurately describe it. That is a catastrophe, because you cannot rally the people to save something they have never had explained to them. So let me tell you plainly what this bill does: The SAVE Act bars noncitizens from voting, so that only American citizens ever cast a ballot in an American election. And it requires photo ID to vote. Period. That is the whole fight, in two sentences. And the American people are with us by margins you almost never see in politics. Nearly 80% want proof of citizenship to register. More than 8 in 10 support voter ID, including most Democrats, most independents, every background and every region. It is 5 to 1. Yet every single Democrat is fighting to block it. Every one. I have spent a lifetime in these battles, and I will tell you the hard truth. You never win reform inside Washington, D.C. The lobbyists and the entrenched forces always control the inside game. Reagan understood this. His job, he said, was to shine a light on the American people so they would turn up the heat on Congress. Tip O'Neill once admitted to me that Reagan's speeches cost him 46 Democrats in a single fight. That is exactly how we win this one. Not with insiders. With a grassroots army of patriots like you, moving all at once. | "RESPOND NOW" This cannot wait. Every day we let slide, they inflate their count, redraw another map, and lock in more stolen power. The clock is running and it is running against us. On the 250th anniversary of American independence, we will decide whether Lincoln's government "of the people, by the people, and for the people" endures, or whether we hand it over to the radicals without a fight. Thank you for your time and participation. subject: She held a tea party of her own
body:
Episode 3: the women who defied a king
[](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Ffoundation/1/0100019f81405cba-b849eae5-f8f2-44f5-8720-540cbacd5145-000000/8nYmX2vV-meYF3TU8FuGDz8XccFCrzrRzwU8hY7Zv28=452)Patriot–Ten months after a group of men threw British tea into Boston Harbor, a woman in North Carolina held a tea party of her own.Her name was Penelope Barker. On October 25, 1774, in the small port town of Edenton, she gathered fifty-one women and asked them to do something almost no American women had done before. She asked them to sign their names to a public act of political defiance.Together, they pledged to stop buying British tea and British cloth until the Crown stopped trampling the rights of the colonies. Then they sent that signed resolution across the ocean to England, out in the open, with every name attached for the world to read.This was not safe. Women were told in those days that politics was no place for them. When word of the Edenton women reached London, the newspapers mocked them and a cartoonist drew them as fools. One British writer sneered that the only comfort was that few American towns had so much “female artillery.”Penelope Barker signed anyway. Her husband was an ocean away in England. She had already buried children of her own. And still she stood up, put her name down, and dared a king to do something about it.That is the woman at the heart of Episode 3 of Defiant Ones, and it is available right now.**Here is how to listen:**[_**Visit the website and start Episode 3.**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Ffoundation%2Fdefiant-ones%2F/1/0100019f81405cba-b849eae5-f8f2-44f5-8720-540cbacd5145-000000/SsszwkaTqhc9Y020xPLwNLxsidVcJ_SaKKM1flWtQm4=452) While you are there, request the family discussion guide you can use around the dinner table or in a classroom. It costs nothing.If you are just joining us, start at the very beginning with Episode 1 and the story of Abigail Adams, or go straight to Penelope in Episode 3. Either way, I do not think you will want to stop.Tea Party Patriots Foundation is honored to help bring this series to you, alongside the team that created it, as our country prepares to mark 250 years of independence.Two hundred and fifty years ago, women like Penelope Barker refused to sit quietly on the sidelines of history. The least we can do is learn their names.[_**Go listen.**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Ffoundation%2Fdefiant-ones%2F/2/0100019f81405cba-b849eae5-f8f2-44f5-8720-540cbacd5145-000000/QB1S2x_3GgHW-0ywZzrfwVOk6ErKhuTCK4Q-JSYAWRc=452) Then forward this to someone who loves this country and the true story of how it was won.In liberty,Jenny Beth Martin

body:
It's sad.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3575%2E21716%2EODK-Z5)
I want to share something with you as a person who sees it up close:
One of the most jarring things I’ve learned since coming to Congress is that for so many of my colleagues on the other side of the aisle, _**the cruelty really is the point**_.
In many cases, they believe the harm they’re inflicting — whether it’s gutting Medicaid and SNAP or targeting vulnerable communities — is aimed at people who don’t vote for them. But the truth is, they’re hurting their own constituents, _and they don’t seem to care._
What makes it worse is how much of it is for show.
Behind closed doors, they act one way — and they go out, put on this MAGA character to suck up to daddy and get clicks and attention on social media.
**It’s sad.**
Because Congress is a place of such profound importance, and there’s a profound potential to do good. It’s why I came here — to govern, lead with compassion, and fight for my neighbors in Delaware. To roll up my sleeves and stay focused on making life easier for working people, even when the other side treats cruelty as a strategy and public office as a show.
**If you believe that matters — if you want to keep this kind of leadership in Congress — I’m asking for your support today.** [**Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260720-1.HqYaEl&refcode=em20260720-3575&amount=5&t=2&akid=3575%2E21716%2EODK-Z5)

name: David Hogg
subject: While they fight to go backward, we’re building forward
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
While Republicans push an agenda that leaves working people behind, our candidates are fighting back.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260720-1&t=1&akid=3751%2E587540%2EZxSJGe)
Peter,
Across the country, Republican state legislatures are running the same playbook — and the American people are paying the price.
They’re threatening our freedoms, trying to weaken our communities, and putting power into the hands of people who already have too much of it.
**In Texas, Governor Greg Abbott and Republican leaders like Dustin Burrows** have pushed private school voucher legislation that drains funding from public classrooms, expanded state cooperation with ICE (as the contractors making billions from running detention centers cut checks to the politicians making them rich), dismissed the urgency of the climate crisis even as Texas communities face increasingly severe and deadly weather events, and worked to strip recognition of BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ historical figures from public life.
**Meanwhile, Christian Menefee** is pressing the EPA for answers about contamination threatening communities in his district, fighting for clean drinking water, and demanding thorough investigations into recent ICE shootings. He also introduced the Block the Bombs Act, and made it clear that he'll only answer to the people he represents — not corporate interests or billionaires.
**In Tennessee, Governor Bill Lee** signed racist redistricting maps designed to silence Black voters and leaders, supported legislation restricting transgender students' rights and access to gender-affirming care, and backed measures leading to book bans in schools.
**Meanwhile, Justin J. Pearson** has refused to back down in the face of political attacks. He’s fought back against those racist maps that drew him out of his own district, been one of the most fearless voices for meaningful gun safety legislation since the Covenant School shooting, and continues speaking out against ICE’s campaign of cruelty while fighting for the communities Tennessee Republicans keep trying to erase.
**In New York, Republican Mike Lawler** has spent his time defending Trump, backing the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, and calling for even more U.S. military action against Iran — all while opposing every policy that would actually lower costs and expand protections for working families.
**Meanwhile, Mayor Zohran Mamdani** continues to deliver on the promises he made to working New Yorkers. He expanded bus service between Brooklyn and the Bronx, implemented a Click-to-Cancel policy to protect consumers from predatory subscription traps, championed a rent freeze for stabilized tenants, launched free 2-K applications, and continues to advocate for abolishing ICE and building an immigration system rooted in dignity and justice.
**That’s the difference between us and them — and it’s why the work we’re doing at Leaders We Deserve is critical.** We exist to find, fund, and fight for leaders who will not only defend the interests of working people against Republicans, corporations, and billionaires, but make progress towards a vision that gives us hope for the future.
**But running against entrenched political machines isn’t easy. We need you with us to power our work of electing a truly new generation of leaders loyal only to their constituents, not special interest groups.**
**[Will you chip in $5 today to help us elect the next generation of progressive leaders?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260720_1_gop.Hwvf9C&refcode=em20260720-3751&amount=5&t=2&akid=3751%2E587540%2EZxSJGe)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

body:
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=bebe30110af849eeab7ea73a4a70aa96&_e=VVRc2CoOEyskAa6GuS5YpViquWpSEiVS-6XAyf5B8jpWrIzvFfYNEJ2mOCWB6gpkpr9k5UnrwaV7AiCuv18WdarAsV33cmdlyprTUBE6_D6uK5esPl0tITFRHoDcpwzhCkMUCCVHihUkXNBwLBi9X4HXFelsNVI0eaPOYcZ7j8Lz0xPfzQlj73AlHHCMn3AtnszTLVTYn6N6oNPsrvf4Ucb2t-7aHLO7uVpkR_7T6iZ_eUN6RPBmClRTO0RE0OgDnh-C6Ux4SwYBBCIy37HQNsGi6ul4npSGj5xfE-B_YzbiX3uFV5IRoNfqgEBq--SkusxzMz9c2CLu5EFRUyhC2YwVeDW_5svtjwE2r2mAD2gxheRlzyfq1bzvQju9ZIaaSM2TEF6Kd4fHs0hxYVEUVsDoGLVmKUEMF1IdzMFWkNFMVpP8xiGZnfZW2Z0GQs1kULV9WaE9h8g55LbWhoBiahEYb9XFJLLzqdj75wd3aHOdSjFquP3Pe-fKPwQCSOTUdEEwA3BVXaKIvwdktwa5pgKBkgJehM6s2u601bL_-PQZ0BRMp7KA1LCLK82yfnHNTBEB1QstRvSQDuwOISEg3KPuTgWMgctU-wuICO5lATjhNq2_N2bt8SbYnZhdpuQO)
Peter,

A Los Angeles mayoral candidate, Nithya Raman, recently proposed banning backyard barbecues.

No, this is not satire.

A candidate for mayor of America's second-largest city looked at her constituents cooking dinner in their own backyards and saw a problem that needed a government solution.

This is what Ayn Rand described decades ago.

She wrote, _" We are fast approaching the stage of ultimate inversion: the stage where the government is free to do anything it pleases, while the citizens may act only by permission."_

While she was not talking about barbecues, Ayn Rand was talking about the mindset that eventually gets around to barbecues, because **once the state believes it owns your judgment** -- and your property -- your grill is just the next line item.

Peter, this is exactly the kind of small, absurd, telling moment that shows young people what collectivism actually looks like when it runs out of bigger things to control.

I'm Jennifer Anju Grossman, CEO of The Atlas Society, the largest organization in the world dedicated to bringing Ayn Rand's ideas to a new generation. clean_body: Peter, A Los Angeles mayoral candidate, Nithya Raman, recently proposed banning backyard barbecues. No, this is not satire. A candidate for mayor of America's second-largest city looked at her constituents cooking dinner in their own backyards and saw a problem that needed a government solution. This is what Ayn Rand described decades ago. She wrote, " We are fast approaching the stage of ultimate inversion: the stage where the government is free to do anything it pleases, while the citizens may act only by permission." While she was not talking about barbecues, Ayn Rand was talking about the mindset that eventually gets around to barbecues, because once the state believes it owns your judgment -- and your property -- your grill is just the next line item. Peter, this is exactly the kind of small, absurd, telling moment that shows young people what collectivism actually looks like when it runs out of bigger things to control. I'm Jennifer Anju Grossman, CEO of The Atlas Society, the largest organization in the world dedicated to bringing Ayn Rand's ideas to a new generation. We create graphic novels, animated videos, a hit podcast, and a growing slate of educational programs, all designed to meet young people exactly where they already are, on the platforms they already use, in formats built to actually hold their attention. You can put Rand 's ideas in front of more young minds this week, at the exact moment they need to see the pattern, by chipping in $10 or more right now. A councilwoman proposing to regulate your summer cookout is not a fluke. It is what happens downstream of a generation raised to believe that ordinary freedom is itself the emergency. Recent polling has found that 62% of young Americans view socialism favorably, not as a historical curiosity but as a live option. This is not an accident. It is the product of a curriculum that treats achievement as suspect, treats the builders as villains, and treats envy as a form of justice. The Atlas Society is interrupting that pipeline before it finishes the job. We are reaching young people where they already are, on the platforms they already use, with content sharp enough to actually compete for their attention. Our digital reach now stands at 3.5 million. We have 22 John Galt Schools running on five continents. We have produced 42 Draw My Life videos that make Rand's ideas make sense to a 19-year-old scrolling at midnight. That is the whole model. Meet them where they are. Give them Ayn Rand 's ideas before the other side finishes giving them the alternative. One billion young minds is the number we are building toward, one grill joke, one viral video, one Pocket Guide at a time. Every $10 you give reaches 2,000 more of them. With grit, grace, and gratitude, Jennifer Anju Grossman (JAG) CEO, The Atlas Society The Atlas Society is a 501(c)(3) Not For Profit Organization. All donations are tax-deductible.

But he did not meet a child. _He met law enforcement._ Thanks to a brave undercover detective and a sting operation organized by the Harford County Sheriff's Office, Jutras was taken into custody on the spot. He is now behind bars, held without bail. Friend, my name is Eduardo Verastegui. I produced the film _Sound of Freedom_ because I believe that exposing the evil of child exploitation is one of the most urgent callings of our time. And what happened in Baltimore is exactly why **the fight has never been more urgent.** Because this predator was not lurking in the shadows.

He was standing at the front of a classroom. He visited multiple schools every single day. **He had direct access to children** **And no one suspected a thing.** That is the terrifying truth about child exploitation that _Sound of Freedom_ tried to show the world: _evil does not always look like evil. _ It hides behind titles. Behind smiling faces in school hallways. Behind trust. Sheriff Jeffrey Gahler said it plainly after the arrest: _"Someone's child, boy or girl, underage, is going to be criminally assaulted by these people if we're not out there intercepting them."_ **He is right. **And that is exactly why the **Sound of Freedom Foundation exists. **

name: Spencer Stiff
subject: What it takes to heal a forest
body:
Dear Peter,

Save the Redwoods has been protecting and learning from redwood forests for more than a century. I have the honor to see that deep expertise first-hand as Field Operations Manager for Redwoods Rising.

The knowledge our teams bring is the kind that can only be gained by being out in the field. We combine that with cutting-edge science, modern forestry techniques, and the knowledge of our Indigenous partners to help damaged forests recover.

Strategic thinning of degraded, overcrowded forests (above) accelerates an eventual return to old-growth redwood forest conditions (below). Photos by Brett Crandall (top) and Max Forster (below)

This work takes time, but we’re already seeing signs that these forests are healing. Let me show you the science behind Redwoods Rising →

Ponsse harvesters like this are specifically made to work in sensitive environments. Photo by Amy Kumler.

Crowded second-growth forests means trees are competing for resources and light struggles to get through the canopy. None can grow strong in that scenario.

Our experts strategically select which trees to thin to allow other young trees and foliage to fully mature. This is a major step in our goal to restore more than 70,000 acres of redwood forest.

A removed logging road slowly returning to its natural state. Photo by Save the Redwoods League

Old logging roads disrupt the natural terrain of forests, leaving streams buried beneath. The waterways are there, but like clogged plumbing, filled with sediment and debris.

We "daylight” or uncover these buried streams, restoring the landscape so it slopes like a natural hill. This reduces habitat fragmentation and improves downstream water quality.

Redwoods Rising has restored over five miles of streams. Photo by Amy Kumler

One of the most exciting signs of success comes when you see native species return to these ecosystems. By restoring streams to their natural state and rebuilding habitats, we’re recreating conditions to help aquatic species thrive.

That includes endangered salmonids like the coho salmon and steelhead trout. In Redwoods Rising project areas, we’ve already seen fish and amphibians return to their natural habitats.

SUPPORT REDWOODS RISING [https://secure.savetheredwoods.org/a/redwoodsrising?sourceid=1170310&ms=RR_EM13&utm_campaign=K2D-1170310&utm_source=ea-fundraising&utm_medium=email]

This work is careful, hands-on, and fueled by collective centuries of expertise. I’m proud to be part of it— and proud to have people like you with us on this journey. [https://secure.savetheredwoods.org/a/redwoodsrising?sourceid=1170310&ms=RR_EM13&utm_campaign=K2D-1170310&utm_source=ea-fundraising&utm_medium=email]

With Gratitude
Spencer Stiff
